## RM · 6 — read-only status

**Starts:** webhook (`rm-queue-status`).

Answers "what posts next, and when" straight from the `content_queue` table. The gateway calls it for
the Telegram `/queue` command and for status questions in chat.

**Read-only by design** — it has no write node, so a mistake here cannot change the queue.

parameters.pythonCode:
# Just the Instagram queue, soonest first — the gateway answers "what's next on Instagram?" from this.
rows = [i["json"] for i in _items]
q = [r for r in rows if r.get("status") == "ready_to_post"]
q.sort(key=lambda r: str(r.get("scheduled_date") or ""))
out = [{"title": r.get("title_a"), "scheduled_date": str(r.get("scheduled_date") or "")[:10],
        "caption": (r.get("caption") or "")[:300], "card_url": r.get("card_url"),
        "row_id": r.get("row_id")} for r in q]
posted = [r for r in rows if r.get("status") == "posted" and r.get("processed_at")]
posted.sort(key=lambda r: str(r.get("processed_at") or ""), reverse=True)
return [{"json": {"queued": out, "queued_count": len(out),
                  "last_posted": ({"title": posted[0].get("title_a"),
                                   "at": str(posted[0].get("processed_at"))[:19]} if posted else None)}}]
